material_decisions.ruling: Adopt English p1 at d3 for all of gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags and mental seed which causes ... different from one another. It preserves seed as cause, not mistaken effect. HGM gnyis snang says duality/perceives a disparity; Hopkins separately says dualistic appearance. Related original ILL:1873 has deep seeds causing a mistake in the form of the discrepancy, supporting source-specific causal interpretation without replacing C05 English. Tibetan 'khrul pa/mistaken and bag chags/mental seed atoms become part of the complete phrase, with no orphan members. Retaining the whole recast recovers the previously omitted dual-appearance explanation.

Retain mthong lam/path of seeing with mthong/seeing, bar chad med lam with balanced source quotes around uninterrupted, and mthong spang/eliminated by this path, whose this path explicitly refers to the just-named path of seeing. spang bya/negative thoughts is contextually the unwanted mental object. Both sgom spang exponents remain exact. Narrow med/no longer present to no; longer present is temporal redistribution, not med alone. Keep the tighter Tibetan-angle quality instead of very quality; preserve negative prefixes as unique members with subword=true.

Prefer complete de'i tshe recasts at d3 to English d5 point in time, since de supplies this and the phrase gives the time frame. Split bag la nyal/lie dormant into dormant #2 plus gnas/lie; answer bag la nyal takes dormant #4, dropping supplied things. Dormant #3 is an English recap in the objection conclusion without another bag la nyal; no fake null advances past it. rten/basis #1–4 stay distinct. The paired no words are #1,2,4,5; no #3 belongs to distributed mi 'dod and remains unpaired.

Retain the established paired technical compound spang gnyen at d5 over things to be eliminated, and the antidotes which eliminate them, adding unique narrower spang/things to be eliminated and gnyen/antidotes members. HGM explicitly supplies state of mind being eliminated and the state of mind that works against and antidotes which eliminate; the compound owns the opposed pair and their remedial relation, including referential them inside the parent. The final whole compound is source-specific attestation, not newly composed HGM wording.

Keep gzhan/other and yang/as well from Tibetan, rejecting English de bzhin du/as well as the smaller local match. Recover de bzhin du shes par bya'o/apply this reasoning at d3: the demonstrative/manner frame and instruction together license the English recast, while shes par bya'o alone would overclaim this reasoning. This replaces the Tibetan blanket omission and the English d5 authoring.

yod dgos is distributed across we would have to say ... still there; the earlier mi rigs is recast across none ... could; mi 'dod across According to you ... there's no. Their exponents are not absent and they are omitted, not null. Keep narrower skyon/problem and med/no instead of there is no such problem, dropping supplied there/is/such; yid/shes pa and dbang/shes compound members remain. English is exactly 1500 characters, but the entire main paragraph through the antidotes sentence is present: cap E-107 is in appended apparatus ending resu. No untranslated Tibetan is inferred from the cap, and nothing is reconstructed.
